name: Malignant mixed Müllerian tumor of the ovary
aliases: Malignant mixed mesodermal tumor of the ovary

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Histopathological diagnosis criteria for ovarian carcinosarcoma

criteria.description: Presence of both malignant epithelial (carcinomatous) and malignant mesenchymal (sarcomatous) components in ovarian tumor tissue
Immunohistochemical staining demonstrating epithelial markers (e.g., cytokeratin) and mesenchymal markers (e.g., vimentin) in respective tumor components
Imaging evidence of an adnexal mass with heterogeneous solid and cystic components suggestive of mixed tumor

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Histopathological confirmation of both carcinomatous and sarcomatous malignant components with supportive immunohistochemical evidence
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis requires exclusion of metastatic carcinosarcoma from other primary sites.

pathognomonic.symptomName: Pelvic mass with mixed solid and cystic consistency
searchTerms: pelvic mass with solid and fluid parts
mixed cystic and solid pelvic lump

common.symptomName: Abdominal or pelvic pain of moderate intensity

occasional.symptomName: Urinary frequency or urgency due to pelvic mass effect
searchTerms: frequent or urgent urination from pelvic mass
bladder symptoms caused by pelvic tumor
urinary urgency due to mass effect

occasional.symptomName: Lower extremity edema secondary to lymphatic obstruction
searchTerms: lower limb edema due to lymph obstruction
difficulty passing stool due to mass
numbness or weakness from brain metastases
neurological symptoms due to brain cancer spread

imaging: Ultrasound showing complex adnexal mass with solid and cystic areas
CT scan demonstrating heterogeneous ovarian mass with possible local invasion
MRI revealing mixed signal intensity tumor components
other: Histopathology showing biphasic malignant epithelial and mesenchymal components
Immunohistochemistry positive for cytokeratin and vimentin

distinguishingFeatures: Purely epithelial tumor without sarcomatous component
Different immunohistochemical profile lacking mesenchymal markers
History of carcinosarcoma at another primary site (e.g., uterus)

redFlags: Unintentional weight loss with pelvic symptoms
